Pottery Classes & Pottery Painting Near Norwich

Beginner-friendly, no experience needed, through to independent memberships

  • Pottery Wheel Classes

    We offer private one-off pottery wheel sessions for between 1-4 people, or 3 weekly courses for one or two people. If you’d prefer to be in a larger group we offer daytime and evening courses.

    Private events can also be booked for hen parties, birthdays or corporate events.

    Learn More..

  • Hand-Building Classes

    Hand-building courses are available for beginners and intermediates. You will follow step by step guidance as a beginner and encouraged to widen your imagination with the intermediate courses.

    We also have one-off workshops during the year. These range from Make Your Own Mug to Pottery & Prosecco

    Learn More..

  • Pottery Memberships

    If you have experience in creating pottery then our memberships are the perfect chance for you to work independently.

    We offer 3hr, 6hr or 12hr weekly pottery memberships. These can be either wheel throwing or hand-building.

    Learn More..

  • Gift Vouchers

    Pottery workshop gift vouchers make an excellent present for any occasion.

    Did you know the 9th wedding anniversary is pottery?!

    Learn More..

  • Pottery Masterclass

    Our advanced pottery masterclasses are aimed at potters who have completed our Beginners and Intermediate 6 week courses and wish to develop their skills further.

    If you have something to celebrate then look no further! We offer fun and laughter with our private pottery sessions. Enjoy some creative time with your friends, family or work colleagues.
